Author: nosut
Name: Achievement Browser
Description:
Shows every achievement in the game's own category tree, with search and
filters that work across all categories at once.

- Search by name, description or reward
- Filter by reward type (mount, minion, title, ...) and earned status
- Hide achievements whose rewards you already own
- Pin achievements and watch their progress in a small tracker window
Punchline: Search, filter and track achievements without the category maze.

Author: nosut
Name: FlagShare
Description:
Shows party members' map flags as labeled pins on your map and minimap,
and lists them in the /flags window. Click a member's flag to copy it
into your own. Everyone needs FlagShare connected to the same relay.
Punchline: Share your map flag with your party without using chat.
